Stan’s Rolled Gold Sealant: High Pressure Performance

August 25, 2026

Expand

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:27
Instaread

Stan’s new Rolled Gold sealant is specifically formulated to plug holes in higher pressure tires better than their other formulas, allowing you to run less sealant and expect the same sealing properties.

Expand
Expand

High Pressure Performance

The new Rolled Gold sealant is designed for higher pressure applications than previous sealants from Stan’s. It is optimized for sealing holes when under pressures more typically seen in road and gravel bikes. Testing showed that Rolled Gold can seal a puncture that is up to 7.8mm across in a tire pressurized between 35–100 psi.

Rolled Gold Quick Hits

  • Pressure Range 35–100 psi (2.4–6.9 bar).
  • Puncture Protection Round punctures up to 7.8mm at 100 psi; holding at 97 psi post-seal.
  • Dosage As little as 35ml in a 700c x 28mm tire — vs. 50ml for Stan’s Original and 50–
  • 60ml competitive average.
  • Temperature Range -20°F to 120°F
  • Tire Type Road, Gravel, and XC MTB
  • Installation Injectable through the valve — Stan’s Sealant Injector or 125ml/60ml bottles.
  • Formula Biodegradable, water-based, high-latex
  • Natural Latex 100% natural latex — greater tensile strength and adhesion than synthetic latex, less brittle when cured. EUDR compliant
  • Made In USA Formulated, produced, and bottled in the USA by Stan’s.
  • Sizes / SKU / MSRP
    • 500ml – $29.50
    • 125ml – $11.00
    • 60ml – $5.50

How Rolled Gold Works

When a tire is punctured, the sudden pressure differential drives Rolled Gold’s latex solution toward the opening at speed. The rapid pressure change across the puncture — similar to hydrodynamic cavitation — causes latex spheres in the sealant to burst almost instantly. Rolled Gold’s high-latex formula puts more of those spheres to work at the puncture site, while its high (but small) particle content accelerates abrasion and further bursting, building a physical plug fast, even across larger slices.

That performance starts with the latex itself. Rolled Gold uses 100% natural latex rather than synthetic alternatives. Its higher molecular weight forms longer polymer chains, giving it greater tensile strength and stronger adhesion to rubber and casing fibers than synthetic latex can match. Natural latex is also less brittle once cured, so it’s less prone to crumbling and breaking down over the life of the tire—an advantage synthetics still haven’t been able to replicate. It’s a more sustainable choice, too: natural latex is plant-derived and renewable, with rubber trees acting as carbon sinks, versus synthetic latex’s petrochemical origins. Plus, our latex is sustainably sourced, meeting EUDR standards for being deforestation-free.

Where It Fits in the Lineup

Rolled Gold doesn’t replace Stan’s other sealants — it performs better for high-performance road riding. Stan’s Original remains the dependable, versatile choice for everyday riding across disciplines, delivering trusted protection at a slightly more accessible price point, though its higher-volume fill adds weight and isn’t optimized for the higher pressures road and gravel riders run. Race Day is engineered with a higher quantity of, and larger, latex particles for maximum puncture protection in the most demanding conditions, but that particle size limits it from being injected through the valve, adding weight and an extra installation step most road and gravel riders don’t need.

Rolled Gold is purpose-built for the space in between. Engineered specifically for higher-pressure road and gravel tires, it seals just as well—or better—than Stan’s other sealants while requiring less sealant, keeping wheels lighter without asking riders to compromise on reliability.

See more at Stan’s.
